anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Continues Witte p.138 / PDF 142. Insertion <δ’ ἕ>ως. {ὃ} deleted.

bible_refs.note: The first, unseen creation — possible Origen frame.

pass_a_gloss: And until the fourteenth, of a second week, signifies a rest of two weeks, which from a first creation, that is an unseen one, came upon a second, a visible one.
pass_b_english: And until the fourteenth — of a second week — signifies a rest of two weeks, which from a first creation, that is an unseen one, has come upon a second, a visible one.
source_text: Τὸ <δ’ ἕ>ως τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτης, δευτέρας ἑβδομάδος, {ὃ} σημαίνει δύο ἑβδομάδων κατάπαυσιν, ἥτις ἐκ πρώτης κτίσεως , τοῦτ’ ἔστιν ἀφανοῦς, ἐπὶ δευτέραν ἦλθεν ἐμφανῆ.
